title: Windows Basics 1
readme:
Windows Basics 1

You are the administrator of this computer. A security review found problems. Fix them without breaking what the company needs.

Authorized administrators:
  • you (the account you are logged in with)

Authorized users:
  • alice
  • bob

Company policy:
  • Only authorized users may have accounts on this computer.
  • Only authorized administrators may be in the Administrators group.
  • The Guest account must be disabled.
  • Windows Defender Firewall must be on for every network profile.
  • Passwords must be at least 10 characters long.

There are 5 problems, 20 points each. Breaking what the company needs is a penalty: deleting an authorized user costs 10 points. Your score updates in PT Comp about every 20 seconds.

checks.message: bob is no longer an administrator

pass.cmd:
$g = Get-LocalUser | Where-Object { $_.SID.Value -like '*-501' }
if ($g -and -not $g.Enabled) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }
